audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for Joseph in Potiphar's house, YHWH with Joseph, success/prospering language, temptation/refusal, false accusation, prison, and favor with the prison chief.

verses.restored: Joseph had been brought down to Egypt, and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian man, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.

familiar.text: And Joseph was brought down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him of the hands of the Ishmeelites, which had brought him down thither.

modern.text: Meanwhile, Joseph had been taken down to Egypt, where an Egyptian named Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.

original.text: וְיוֹסֵ֖ף הוּרַ֣ד מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיִּקְנֵ֡הוּ פּוֹטִיפַר֩ סְרִ֨יס פַּרְעֹ֜ה שַׂ֤ר הַטַּבָּחִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י מִיַּד֙ הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹרִדֻ֖הוּ שָֽׁמָּה

verses.restored: The Eternal was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, and he was in the house of his Egyptian master.

familiar.text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

modern.text: And the LORD was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, serving in the household of his Egyptian master.

original.text: וַיְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶת יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְהִ֖י אִ֣ישׁ מַצְלִ֑יחַ וַיְהִ֕י בְּבֵ֥ית אֲדֹנָ֖יו הַמִּצְרִֽי

verses.restored: His master saw that the Eternal was with him and that the Eternal made all that he did succeed in his hand.

familiar.text: And his master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did to prosper in his hand.

modern.text: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and made him prosper in all he did,

original.text: וַיַּ֣רְא אֲדֹנָ֔יו כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֔ה יְהוָ֖ה מַצְלִ֥יחַ בְּיָדֽוֹ

verses.restored: Joseph found favor in his eyes and served him, and he appointed him over his house and gave all that he had into his hand.

familiar.text: And Joseph found grace in his sight, and he served him: and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

modern.text: Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household and entrusted him with everything he owned.

original.text: וַיִּמְצָ֨א יוֹסֵ֥ף חֵ֛ן בְּעֵינָ֖יו וַיְשָׁ֣רֶת אֹת֑וֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵ֨הוּ֙ עַל בֵּית֔וֹ וְכָל יֶשׁ ל֖וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדֽוֹ

verses.restored: From the time he appointed him over his house and all that he had, the Eternal blessed the Egyptian’s house because of Joseph; the blessing of the Eternal was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

familiar.text: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the LORD was upon all that he had in the house, and in the field.

modern.text: From the time that he put Joseph in charge of his household and all he owned, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s household on account of him. The LORD’s blessing was on everything he owned, both in his house and in his field.

original.text: וַיְהִ֡י מֵאָז֩ הִפְקִ֨יד אֹת֜וֹ בְּבֵית֗וֹ וְעַל֙ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ ל֔וֹ וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת בֵּ֥ית הַמִּצְרִ֖י בִּגְלַ֣ל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֞י בִּרְכַּ֤ת יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ ל֔וֹ בַּבַּ֖יִת וּבַשָּׂדֶֽה

verses.restored: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand, and with him there he knew nothing except the bread he ate. Joseph was beautiful in form and beautiful in appearance.

familiar.text: And he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.

modern.text: So Potiphar left all that he owned in Joseph’s care; he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,

original.text: וַיַּעֲזֹ֣ב כָּל אֲשֶׁר לוֹ֮ בְּיַד יוֹסֵף֒ וְלֹא יָדַ֤ע אִתּוֹ֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁר ה֣וּא אוֹכֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף יְפֵה תֹ֖אַר וִיפֵ֥ה מַרְאֶֽה

verses.restored: After these things, his master’s woman lifted her eyes toward Joseph and said, Lie with me.

familiar.text: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

modern.text: and after some time his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said, “Sleep with me.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַתִּשָּׂ֧א אֵֽשֶׁת אֲדֹנָ֛יו אֶת עֵינֶ֖יהָ אֶל יוֹסֵ֑ף וַתֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁכְבָ֥ה עִמִּֽי

verses.restored: He refused and said to his master’s woman, Look, with me here my master does not know what is in the house, and he has given all that he has into my hand.

familiar.text: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

modern.text: But he refused. “Look,” he said to his master’s wife, “with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in his house, and he has entrusted everything he owns to my care.

original.text: וַיְמָאֵ֓ן וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל אֵ֣שֶׁת אֲדֹנָ֔יו הֵ֣ן אֲדֹנִ֔י לֹא יָדַ֥ע אִתִּ֖י מַה בַּבָּ֑יִת וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ ל֖וֹ נָתַ֥ן בְּיָדִֽי

verses.restored: No one is greater in this house than I, and he has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his woman. How then could I do this great evil and sin against the Divine?

familiar.text: There is none greater in this house than I; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee, because thou art his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?

modern.text: No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?”

original.text: אֵינֶ֨נּוּ גָד֜וֹל בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּה֮ מִמֶּנִּי֒ וְלֹֽא חָשַׂ֤ךְ מִמֶּ֨נִּי֙ מְא֔וּמָה כִּ֥י אִם אוֹתָ֖ךְ בַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתְּ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨יךְ אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֜ה הָרָעָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְחָטָ֖אתִי לֵֽאלֹהִֽים

verses.restored: Though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he did not listen to her to lie beside her or to be with her.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

modern.text: Although Potiphar’s wife spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be near her.

original.text: וַיְהִ֕י כְּדַבְּרָ֥הּ אֶל יוֹסֵ֖ף י֣וֹם י֑וֹם וְלֹא שָׁמַ֥ע אֵלֶ֛יהָ לִשְׁכַּ֥ב אֶצְלָ֖הּ לִהְי֥וֹת עִמָּֽהּ

verses.restored: One day he came into the house to do his work, and none of the men of the house were there inside.

familiar.text: And it came to pass about this time, that Joseph went into the house to do his business; and there was none of the men of the house there within.

modern.text: One day, however, Joseph went into the house to attend to his work, and not a single household servant was inside.

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ כְּהַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א הַבַּ֖יְתָה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת מְלַאכְתּ֑וֹ וְאֵ֨ין אִ֜ישׁ מֵאַנְשֵׁ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת שָׁ֖ם בַּבָּֽיִת

verses.restored: She seized him by his garment, saying, Lie with me. He left his garment in her hand, fled, and went outside.

familiar.text: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

modern.text: She grabbed Joseph by his cloak and said, “Sleep with me!” But leaving his cloak in her hand, he escaped and ran outside. Joseph Falsely Imprisoned

original.text: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂ֧הוּ בְּבִגְד֛וֹ לֵאמֹ֖ר שִׁכְבָ֣ה עִמִּ֑י וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ בְּיָדָ֔הּ וַיָּ֖נָס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה

verses.restored: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and fled outside,

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and was fled forth,

modern.text: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,

original.text: וַיְהִי֙ כִּרְאוֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי עָזַ֥ב בִּגְד֖וֹ בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַיָּ֖נָס הַחֽוּצָה

verses.restored: she called to the men of her house and spoke to them, saying, See, he has brought us a Hebrew man to laugh at us. He came to me, and I cried out with a loud voice.

familiar.text: That she called unto the men of her house, and spake unto them, saying, See, he hath brought in an Hebrew unto us to mock us; he came in unto me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice:

modern.text: she called her household servants. “Look,” she said, “this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us. He came to me so he could sleep with me, but I screamed as loud as I could.

original.text: וַתִּקְרָ֞א לְאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵיתָ֗הּ וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר רְא֗וּ הֵ֥בִיא לָ֛נוּ אִ֥ישׁ עִבְרִ֖י לְצַ֣חֶק בָּ֑נוּ בָּ֤א אֵלַי֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ב עִמִּ֔י וָאֶקְרָ֖א בְּק֥וֹל גָּדֽוֹל

verses.restored: When he heard that I lifted my voice and cried out, he left his garment beside me, fled, and went outside.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.

modern.text: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֣י כְשָׁמְע֔וֹ כִּֽי הֲרִימֹ֥תִי קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֤ב בִּגְדוֹ֙ אֶצְלִ֔י וַיָּ֖נָס וַיֵּצֵ֥א הַחֽוּצָה

verses.restored: She kept his garment beside her until his master came home.

familiar.text: And she laid up his garment by her, until his lord came home.

modern.text: So Potiphar’s wife kept Joseph’s cloak beside her until his master came home.

original.text: וַתַּנַּ֥ח בִּגְד֖וֹ אֶצְלָ֑הּ עַד בּ֥וֹא אֲדֹנָ֖יו אֶל בֵּיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant whom you brought to us came to me to laugh at me.

familiar.text: And she spake unto him according to these words, saying, The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me:

modern.text: Then she told him the same story: “The Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me,

original.text: וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו כַּדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לֵאמֹ֑ר בָּֽא אֵלַ֞י הָעֶ֧בֶד הָֽעִבְרִ֛י אֲשֶׁר הֵבֵ֥אתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְצַ֥חֶק בִּֽי

verses.restored: When I lifted my voice and cried out, he left his garment beside me and fled outside.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.

modern.text: but when I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house.”

original.text: וַיְהִ֕י כַּהֲרִימִ֥י קוֹלִ֖י וָאֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲזֹ֥ב בִּגְד֛וֹ אֶצְלִ֖י וַיָּ֥נָס הַחֽוּצָה

verses.restored: When his master heard the words his woman spoke to him, saying, This is what your servant did to me, his anger burned.

familiar.text: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

modern.text: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, “This is what your slave did to me,” he burned with anger.

original.text: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אֲדֹנָ֜יו אֶת דִּבְרֵ֣י אִשְׁתּ֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּרָ֤ה אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כַּדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה עָ֥שָׂהּ לִ֖י עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וַיִּ֖חַר אַפּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Joseph’s master took him and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined, and he was there in the prison.

familiar.text: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

modern.text: So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison where the king’s prisoners were confined. While Joseph was there in the prison,

original.text: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֲדֹנֵ֨י יוֹסֵ֜ף אֹת֗וֹ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֨הוּ֙ אֶל בֵּ֣ית הַסֹּ֔הַר מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר אסורי הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲסוּרִ֑ים וַֽיְהִי שָׁ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית הַסֹּֽהַר

verses.restored: But the Eternal was with Joseph and stretched covenant-kindness to him, and gave him favor in the eyes of the chief of the prison.

familiar.text: But the LORD was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

modern.text: the LORD was with him and extended kindness to him, granting him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.

original.text: וַיְהִ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֶת יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיֵּ֥ט אֵלָ֖יו חָ֑סֶד וַיִּתֵּ֣ן חִנּ֔וֹ בְּעֵינֵ֖י שַׂ֥ר בֵּית הַסֹּֽהַר

verses.restored: The chief of the prison gave into Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison; whatever they did there, he was the one doing it.

familiar.text: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners that were in the prison; and whatsoever they did there, he was the doer of it.

modern.text: And the warden put all the prisoners under Joseph’s care, so that he was responsible for all that was done in the prison.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן שַׂ֤ר בֵּית הַסֹּ֨הַר֙ בְּיַד יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ֣אֲסִירִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית הַסֹּ֑הַר וְאֵ֨ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֹשִׂים֙ שָׁ֔ם ה֖וּא הָיָ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה

verses.restored: The chief of the prison did not look into anything in Joseph’s hand, because the Eternal was with him, and whatever he did, the Eternal made it succeed.

familiar.text: The keeper of the prison looked not to any thing that was under his hand; because the LORD was with him, and that which he did, the LORD made it to prosper.

modern.text: The warden did not concern himself with anything under Joseph’s care, because the LORD was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.

original.text: אֵ֣ין שַׂ֣ר בֵּית הַסֹּ֗הַר רֹאֶ֤ה אֶֽת כָּל מְא֨וּמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ בַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אִתּ֑וֹ וַֽאֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא עֹשֶׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה מַצְלִֽיחַ
